title: wisdom born from authority, not cleaved from knowledge spills over with Truth dousing away candor in an eddy of riposte bubbling, fermenting swirling
summary: wisdom born from authority, not cleaved from knowledge spills over with Truth dousing away candor in an eddy of riposte bubbling, fermenting swirling in righteousness only found by gouging out the Owl's third eye #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
wisdom
  born from
authority,
not cleaved
  from
knowledge
  spills over
with Truth
dousing away
candor in an
eddy of riposte
bubbling, fermenting
swirling in
righteousness
only found
by gouging out
the Owl's
third eye
#smallpoems
